params.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 7-second vertical food-app commercial sequence at 9:16. The supplied starting image is an ORIGINAL SYNTHETIC CASTING SHEET made for this commercial: nine invented adult performers, not photos of real customers. Preserve these exact fictional characters. The other image is the original generated food concept for the recipe: a bright transparent yellow scalloped vegetable gelatin ring with green celery, bell pepper and onion suspended inside, center hole, on a home plate.
0–2 seconds: animate the nine people in the exact 3x3 starting grid. Each has a different lively reaction: surprised gasp, delighted laugh, playful disbelief. Clear natural face motion and small head gestures, no static slideshow. Keep all nine portraits distinct.
2–5 seconds: clean hard cut to three vertical kitchen panels. Feature the three performers from the middle row of the starting image: the man in the burgundy T-shirt at left, the woman with the blue apron at center, the older man in the mustard shirt at right. They are in three different home kitchens actively making the same gelatin recipe. Left stirs yellow mixture and chopped green vegetables in a glass bowl. Center pours the mixture into a ring-shaped mold. Right lifts a ring mold away from a completed yellow vegetable gelatin ring. Show faces, hands and actual actions. Different ordinary kitchens and distinct home plates, warm natural light. No digital text or UI.
5–7 seconds: keep those three vertical panels and the same three performers. Each now has their own homemade yellow vegetable gelatin ring with a slightly different finish. They aim black smartphones at their own plates and take a photo. The completed dishes must be clearly visible in the LOWER HALF of each panel, with the actors' faces above. Plates are white at left, light blue at center and lightly patterned at right. End holding those three actual scene views long enough to see the dishes. No floating reference pictures.
Punchy comic advertising rhythm, believable hands, realistic food, warm color and natural camera action. Audio: light overlapping laughter and gasps, then a stir/pour/unmold sound and three camera shutter clicks. No music, no spoken statements, no names, no typography, no logos, no watermarks, no onscreen labels, no extra people entering a panel. Commercial dramatization with fictional performers.
